title: geranium dissectum var. carolinianum
intro: Geranium dissectum var. carolinianum, commonly known as Carolina Geranium, is a species of flowering plant in the family Geraniaceae. It is often used in herbal medicine due to its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce anxiety and stress, improve digestion, and support the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Carolina Geranium include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic properties, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents in Carolina Geranium have been shown to have antimicrobial, anti-cancer, and anti-inflammatory effects, making it a valuable plant in traditional medicine.
